name: Kono Ai wa ￭￭ Dake no Mono
source:
Itsuki 's childhood friends are twin sisters, Seira and Hoshina.
He thought he'd spend peaceful days eating lunch and studying with them.
But one day, Itsuki is forced to make a certain choice...
